question: On the same qualified RA02R fine-node hydraulic states, is the remaining R16 root-uptake discrepancy already present in the static Feddes functional, and how much of that functional discrepancy is attributable to within-layer Feddes threshold nonlinearity versus the mismatch between a storage-derived representative head and the root-weighted pressure-head distribution?

domain.diagnostic_hydraulic_state: qualified RA02R fine-node committed state immediately before each prescribed root-sink evaluation

notation.w_j: exact fine-node root fraction over node j
notation.DeltaF_i: sum of exact w_j in retained R16 layer i
notation.alpha_j: unchanged Feddes drought alpha at fine-node pressure head h_j
notation.theta_bar_i: water-volume mean theta in retained R16 layer i
notation.h_root_i: root-fraction-weighted mean pressure head in retained R16 layer i

exact_decomposition.crossing_diagnostic: A retained layer is h3- or h4-crossing when the corresponding threshold lies between the minimum and maximum fine-node pressure head in that layer.
interpretation: A isolates the nonlinearity of alpha across a within-layer threshold after replacing the fine distribution by its exact root-weighted mean pressure head.
B isolates the information lost when the candidate uses a storage-derived representative head instead of root-weighted pressure-head information.
Because all three functionals are evaluated on the same fine-node Reference state, reduced hydraulic propagation D is absent from this diagnostic.

metrics: per-transaction A and B with exact A+B identity check
per-layer exact, root-head and storage-mean contributions
per-history RMSE and max absolute total/A/B fractional functional errors
fraction of absolute layerwise functional error occurring in threshold-crossing layers
fraction of transactions containing an h3 or h4 crossing in root support

numerical_distinguishability.provenance: Reuse the already frozen RA02R 64*Nmax*binary64-epsilon roundoff guard with Nmax=2048.
numerical_distinguishability.use: Only classify a static functional contribution as numerically distinguishable when its absolute magnitude exceeds this guard. This is not an application tolerance.

interpretation_rules.static_functional_missing_information_su: R16 fine-state F_R16-F_exact is numerically distinguishable on at least one qualified material/history trajectory.
interpretation_rules.A_supported: A exceeds the frozen numerical guard; threshold-crossing information contributes independently on the same Reference state.
interpretation_rules.B_supported: B exceeds the frozen numerical guard; root-weighted pressure-head information contributes independently on the same Reference state.
interpretation_rules.A_and_B_mixed: Both A and B are numerically distinguishable. Report magnitudes and cancellation without selecting a state.
interpretation_rules.neither_static_component_explains_stage3: Neither A nor B is numerically distinguishable despite the Stage3 dynamic R16 failure; only then may a later diagnostic revisit D or E.

decision_constraints: No new reduced state, root-specific state, moment, partition or hydraulic closure.
No fitted coefficient, correction, relaxation or memory variable.
No application tolerance derived from the diagnostic response.
Do not label A or B dominant using a response-derived cutoff; report exact decomposition and numerical distinguishability only.
